description: This file is a shell script for testing Git behavior, specifically related to handling directory to symlink conversions and merges involving symlinks. It defines a series of test cases to verify how Git manages merging, conflicts, and untracked files with symlinks and directories.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, taking a description and a command sequence.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the provided command sequence should fail.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_ln_s_add
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link and stages it for commit.
